title: Information Asset Protection Policy — System & Application Security
overview: Defines mandatory baseline security requirements for all software applications, COTS platforms, and infrastructure hosted within Johnson & Johnson environments.

sections.title: Security Assessment for COTS Systems/Applications
sections.requirement: All commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) and internally developed software must undergo a formal security assessment prior to deployment.

sections.title: ISRM Approval Prior to Production
sections.requirement: Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) approval must be formally documented and recorded prior to production release.

sections.title: Periodic Application Architecture/Code/Config Assessment
sections.requirement: Periodic re-assessment of system architecture, configuration baselines, and code security posture must be conducted at minimum every 12 months.

title: Identity & Access Management Governance Policy
overview: Establishes controls for identity lifecycle management, privileged account governance, and recurring user access recertification.

sections.title: Privileged User Access Recertification Review
sections.requirement: Comprehensive privileged account listings must be reviewed and recertified quarterly by business and system owners.

sections.title: Semi-Annual User Access Certification
sections.requirement: Semi-annual recertification must identify and isolate dormant accounts with active entitlements across all enterprise systems.

sections.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Enforcement
sections.requirement: Multi-Factor Authentication is mandatory for all administrative access, external network access, and elevated privilege roles.

title: Automated System Telemetry Logging & Monitoring Policy
overview: Prescribes requirements for continuous shopfloor telemetry, sensor calibration drift monitoring, and event log ingestion.

sections.title: Automated System Telemetry Logging & Monitoring
sections.requirement: Automated monitoring pipelines must continuously ingest sensor telemetry and trigger supervisory alarms when tolerance thresholds are breached.

sections.title: Hardware Integrity & Recalibration Protocols
sections.requirement: Mandatory gain verification and recalibration cycles must be executed and logged during continuous multi-batch production runs.

title: GxP Audit Trail & Electronic Records Retention Policy
overview: Enforces global regulatory compliance for computerized systems validation, audit trails, and electronic record retention schedules.

sections.title: GxP Audit Trail & Log Retention Policy
sections.requirement: Operational and access logs for all GxP validated systems must be archived immutably for a mandatory minimum period of 7 years.

sections.title: Vendor Hosted Application Verification
sections.requirement: Third-party cloud software providers hosting GxP regulated data must contractually demonstrate automated immutable log archiving and disaster recovery.

title: Inventory Variance & Scrap Reconciliation Protocol
overview: Governs the verification, reconciliation, and managerial approvals required for manufacturing material losses and scrap variances.

sections.title: Inventory Variance & Scrap Reconciliation Protocol
sections.requirement: Material variances exceeding defined standard cost tolerances must undergo documented supervisory review and root-cause reconciliation.

sections.title: Batch Integrity & Financial Material Scrap Verification
sections.requirement: Mandatory secondary financial review and controller sign-off is required for any single batch scrap occurrence exceeding $25,000.
